correctness.rationale: The normal-form relation ba=a^{-1}b gives all exponents r-2t for 0<=t<=r when s>0. Odd b-counts cannot give identity; the three even cases follow from b^2=a^m. Exact suffix-quotion classification has (m-1)+2m+4(m-1)+4=7m-1 reachable classes, with explicit distinguishing witnesses. Finite group-product DP and suffix-equivalence tests pass independently for m=2..10; only the proof supports the infinite quantifier.

value.rationale: Gives a uniform and sharp minimal automaton classification for every group in a natural infinite family of finite nonabelian dicyclic groups, with the smallest quaternion case included. The nontrivial central b-square produces a genuine transient threshold absent from the dihedral case and makes commutative closure increase state count from 4m to 7m-1. This is a structural state-complexity benchmark for the general bounds rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
